data.name: Nora
data.gender_notes: Nora is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin honor, 'honour', or a short form of Eleonora. Its root is Latin honor. A Christian name used across Europe. Nora is a Latin name meaning “Light; honour”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nora expresses “Light; honour”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Latin honor, 'honour', or a short form of Eleonora.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nora total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
